about_the_game:
About This Game

Melon Bounce is a casual puzzle game where you drag and launch cute fruits like billiard balls, making them bounce and merge into bigger ones.
Starting from small cherries or blueberries, your goal is to keep combining and evolving fruits until you finally create the sweet and juicy melon.

But is melon really the end…? Perhaps something beyond awaits those who push further.

Features

  • 🎮 Simple controls, surprising depth
    Just drag to set the angle and power, then launch your fruit. Easy to play, but mastering high scores takes skill and precision.

  • 🍊 The joy of merging
    Watch as matching fruits collide, bounce, and transform into larger varieties. Each step forward is satisfying and keeps you coming back.

  • 😆 Lively fruit characters
    Every fruit has its own facial expressions and cute animations, making them feel alive rather than just objects.

  • 🏝️ Relaxing seaside stage
    Play against the backdrop of a warm beach, with bright and colorful visuals that bring a cozy atmosphere.

  • 🏆 Global leaderboard challenge
    Climb the leaderboard and prove your skills against players worldwide. Competing for the top spot is a core part of the fun.

Your Challenge

The sweet thrill of completing a melon… and the curiosity of what may come after.
How far can you go, and how high can you climb on the global ranking?

It’s time to bounce into Melon Bounce!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 10, Windows 11, Window 7 SP1 or Higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with DirectX 10 or higher support (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or above)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Inspired by the Suika Game, this game offers a completely new kind of fun with billiard-style gameplay. Adjust the angle and power to bounce the cute fruits like billiard balls, merge them, and create a melon!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil
